Each cycle contribution for x∈P is a G-conjugate in P of x^{n_i}; by abelian-Sylow fusion it is N_G(P)-conjugate, hence equals x^{n_i} because P centralizes N_G(P). Thus V(x)=x^{[G:P]}.
